verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਜਬ ਤੇ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਾਏ ਤਬ ਤੇ ਅਸਥਰਿ ਚਿਤ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਧਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal gur jab te ridhai basaae tab te asathar chit anat na dhaavahee ||

en.bdb: Since the time a human being attaches his mind with the lotus like feet of the True Guru, his mind becomes stable and it does not wander anywhere.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਅਮਰ ਪਦ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal makara(n)dh charanaamirat kai praapat amar padh sahaj samaavahee ||

en.bdb: The refuge of the True Guru's feet provides one with the foot-wash of the True Guru that helps him acquire inimitable state and engrossment in equipoise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੁਖ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਕੀਉ ਆਨ ਸੁਖ ਤਿਆਗ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal sukh man mai nivaas keeau aan sukh tiaag har naam liv laavahee ||

en.bdb: Since the holy feet of the True Guru got lodged in the heart of a devotee (the devotee took His refuge), the mind of the devotee has shed all other comforts and is absorbed in the meditation of His name.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਵਾਸਨਾ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਆਨ ਵਾਸ ਫੀਕੀ ਭਈ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ॥੨੧੮॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal makara(n)dh vaasanaa nivaas aan vaas feekee bhiee hiradhe na bhaaviee ||218||

en.bdb: Since the fragrance of the holy lotus-feet of the True Guru got lodged in the mind of the devotee, all other fragrances have become prosaic and indifferent for him. (218)
